_source: The September rehearsal, run on GCE with the real k6 binary against health endpoints and the frontend entrypoint only. NOTE: the k6 summary output was printed to a terminal and was NOT archived, so these are the values as reported in the report's Table 1, transcribed here. They are not a machine-readable k6 export and no per-stage breakdown survives.
_do_not_mix: This run used a different workload from the October study (health + / only, no catalogue) and a different cluster, so its numbers are not comparable stage-for-stage with load-2026-10-16.json.
